# homeassistant_integration (Data Source)

Reads one config entry of an integration, e.g. one set up in the UI. Exactly one entry must match `domain` and, if set, `title`. The data the entry was created with cannot be read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The one config entry of a domain.
data "homeassistant_integration" "met" {
  domain = "met"
}

# Pick one of several entries by its title.
data "homeassistant_integration" "chores" {
  domain = "local_calendar"
  title  = "Chores"
}

output "met_state" {
  value = data.homeassistant_integration.met.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Integration domain, e.g. `met`.

### Optional

- `title` (String) Title of the entry, as shown in the UI. Set it to pick one of several entries of the domain.

### Read-Only

- `disabled_by` (String) Who disabled the entry, e.g. `user`; null if it is enabled.
- `entry_id` (String) The entry's `entry_id`, the same as `id`.
- `id` (String) The entry's `entry_id`.
- `state` (String) State of the entry, e.g. `loaded` or `setup_error`.
